method: Exact finite-state enumeration; not Monte Carlo. Percentages are per full shooting activation.

rows.name: Magnus
rows.note: Both guns; no ritual, stratagem or offensive Kindred Sorcery.

rows.name: Magnus · Maelstrom + Devastating Sorcery
rows.note: Psychic +1 to wound and full hit/wound rerolls (failed rolls rerolled). 2CP, or 3CP if Egotistical Power is needed to select/reuse Maelstrom. No ritual required.

rows.name: 10 Scarabs + Terminator Sorcerer
rows.note: Marked by Fate +1 to hit, Lethal Hits; 9 combi-bolters total with Rapid Fire. Gaze of Hate included.

rows.name: 10 Scarabs + Terminator Sorcerer
rows.note: Same buffs; no Rapid Fire. Beyond 18″ Gaze of Hate is out of range, so do not use this row.

rows.name: 10 Scarabs + Terminator Sorcerer
rows.note: No Rapid Fire; Gaze of Hate cannot reach. Marked by Fate and Lethal Hits included.

rows.name: 5 Rubrics + Sorcerer
rows.note: Flamers out of range; soulreaper, Malefic Curse and Delusion only. Wound rerolls of 1 and Lethal Hits included.

rows.name: 5 Rubrics + Sorcerer
rows.note: Three flamers, soulreaper, Malefic Curse and Delusion; Lethal Hits and wound rerolls of 1. No pistols alongside that model’s other guns.

rows.name: Rubrics + Sorcerer · enemy objective
rows.note: Target within an objective you do not control: full failed-wound rerolls replace rerolls of 1.

rows.name: Rubrics + Sorcerer · objective + once-per-battle burst
rows.note: As above, plus Twisted Sorceries makes Delusion 9 attacks at S8. Does not spend CP; once per battle per Sorcerer.

rows.name: 2 Sekhetar Robots · missiles only
rows.note: Four missile shots; flamers and meltaguns cannot reach.

rows.name: 2 Sekhetar Robots
rows.note: Both flamers, both missile racks and both meltaguns; no Melta bonus.

rows.name: 2 Sekhetar Robots · Melta
rows.note: Same guns; meltaguns deal D6+2 damage.

rows.name: Winged Prince · Eldritch Vortex
rows.note: Vortex makes Dark Blessing S5/D2. Hunter of Souls rerolls hit/wound 1s against the attached Character units. No Aetherstride or offensive Kindred Sorcery.

rows.name: Exalted Sorcerer on Disc
rows.note: Arcane Fire only; Incandaeum adds a possible extra Doombolt, not a weapon-profile buff. Binding Tendrils slows hit Infantry even when they survive.

rows.name: 3 bow Enlightened
rows.note: Six shots. Precision is deliberately not used: these columns measure bodyguard removal, not character sniping.
